## 💡 Key Questions to Ask Any Consultant

When you speak to these firms, make sure to ask:

1. **"Can you connect to our existing ERP via API or connector — without replacing it?"** (e.g. SAP, MYOB, Epicor, Pronto, etc.)
2. **"Have you built shop-floor data capture apps using Power Apps?"** (e.g. production counts, quality checks, machine downtime logging)
3. **"Can Power Automate handle our order processing workflows end-to-end?"**
4. **"Do you offer post-implementation support and training for our floor staff?"**
5. **"Are you a Microsoft Solutions Partner?"** (ensures certified expertise)
